name: rodev-omni-enterprise
description: Full-Fidelity Roblox Script Executor, 3D Spatial Simulator, Visual UI Diffing & Remote Security Fuzzer MCP Server

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/harness', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/harness/mock_roblox.lua', 'dist/harness/mock_roblox.lua'); if (fs.existsSync('src/harness/render.cjs')) fs.copyFileSync('src/harness/render.cjs', 'dist/harness/render.cjs'); fs.copyFileSync('src/harness/render.js', 'dist/harness/render.js');"
scripts.test:all: tsx test/verifyEnterpriseSuite.ts && tsx test/verify3dWorldSimulation.ts && tsx test/verifyInteractiveDashboard.ts && tsx test/verifyGameSimulationSuite.ts
